LightningComponentBundle.description: Configurable metric panel with donut chart for visualizing child record data

property.name: panelTitle
property.label: Panel Title (Optional)
property.description: Custom title for the panel. Leave blank to use default.

property.name: donutTitleOverride
property.label: Donut Chart Title (Optional)
property.description: Override the donut chart title from metadata. Leave blank to use metadata value.

property.name: metricLabel1
property.label: Metric Label 1 (Optional)
property.description: Override label for the first metric (by display order). Leave blank to use metadata value.

property.name: metricLabel2
property.label: Metric Label 2 (Optional)
property.description: Override label for the second metric (by display order). Leave blank to use metadata value.

property.name: hideWhenEmpty
property.label: Hide When Empty
property.description: Hide the entire panel when there is no data (total count is 0)
